acceptance: Determine whether the existing dependency audit (_project/scripts/dependency_audit, audit-deps) or any advisory scanner reports on the bundled wheel; record the result.
If not, add an automated check that maps the pinned upstream version to published SQLGlot advisories and fails or alerts on a match, with a test.
The release guide names the check and who acts on it.
description: BenchBox now ships SQLGlot as a private wheel inside package data (benchbox/_vendor). Package-level dependency scanners and advisory feeds key on declared requirements, so a CVE in SQLGlot no longer surfaces against BenchBox. The inventory row in docs/internal/dependency-inventory.md records the bundle by hand only.
